subject: SELF and SUPER
notes: Rule (--check 8.4.3.8.3 'This identifier format may be specified only in a method definition' -> OK §8.4.3.8.3 1)). Every surface SELF/SUPER can appear on is guarded: INVOKE SELF|SUPER and the inline form (OoBindByReceiver: !host.InMethod || OoCurrentClass null -> COBOL0827), SET ... TO SELF (OoCurrentClass null -> 0867), RAISE SELF (EcBinder 0848). Probe probe/self-and-super/PSR1.cob in a PROGRAM: INVOKE SELF, INVOKE SUPER, MOVE SELF :: "M" TO X, RAISE SELF -> four targeted rejections citing SR1. Note: if F2 widens SELF to general identifier positions, those new positions need this same guard. [editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (OO predefined object references; absent from COBOL-85)]
